class_artifacts.description: Per-class required disk verdict artifacts (BL-W48 artifact-floor). Replaces the obsolete class_floors/mandatory_peers roster. Keys are wave class names (HARNESS, DOC, FAST-PATH).

architects.description: Fixed list of arch-<role> whose VERIFY-FINAL verdict is required, OR the sentinel string "declared" meaning PLAN.md carries a literal `**Required-Architects**: <role>[, ...]` token the gate resolves.

qg.description: Whether canonical QG artifacts (quality-gate-report.json + stamps + push-proof.json) are required before push.

lifecycle_roles.description: Class-aware roles passed to the shipped Wave-1 lifecycle manager; distinct from architect verdict requirements.

execution_mode.description: Measured topology-pilot result for this wave class; runtime connectors implement the mode through the shared lifecycle.

default_class.description: Default wave class when the CLASS sentinel / PLAN **Class** token is absent. Fail-safe: HARNESS.

sentinel_dir.description: Directory (relative to project root) where wave quality-gate sentinels are stored. Default: .claude/wave-quality-gates

sentinel_filename_template.description: Filename template for quality-gate sentinels. {slug} is replaced with the wave slug. Default: {slug}.md
